transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Ever since a friend from my choir passed away so suddenly, I just haven’t been myself. I cry over little things like potluck lists, and calls I used to handle easily get me all worked up. I’ve even started missing church planning things I never would’ve missed before.
How long ago did your friend pass away?
About a month ago now—since my close friend from choir died.
Are you having unwanted, upsetting memories or nightmares about your friend's passing?
I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed nightmares or memories that come back like that.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy, like singing in the choir?
I'm not really sure. I haven't thought of it that way.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling sad, down, or depressed for most of the day, nearly every day?
Yes... I’ve been pretty down most days since she died. Little things set me off—I’ll cry looking at the potluck lists, and calls I used to handle easily feel overwhelming.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, such as trouble falling asleep or waking up during the night?
I’m not sure—I haven’t really paid much attention to my sleep lately.
Have you been feeling down on yourself, like you're worthless or letting others down?
I’m not sure. I don’t really know if I’d say I feel worthless—I just haven’t thought about it that way.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed whether my energy has changed.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to die or wishing you weren't alive?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought about that or noticed having thoughts like that.
